title: the data TrialBox needs from a hospital and how its codes are mapped (lane M, 2026-11-23)

findings.claim: A Japanese diagnosis reaches a criterion only when its WHO ICD-10 code is also an ICD-10-CM code (D-314, services/adapter/sources/ssmix2/source.py:1617-1620); every shipped diagnosis value set is ICD-10-CM and no WHO-to-CM cross-walk exists, so E14, I64 or F00 read unknown at a Japanese site

The department criteria (GZQO-INC-09, NEUR-COH-INC-02) match TrialBox's own department codes, but the mappings write the hospital's department code as it is (tw_core/demo_his.yaml:124; PV1-10 on SS-MIX2) and the site profile has no department table, so a hospital with its own codes reads unknown

The SS-MIX2 reader reads no procedure type (source.py:108-114) and the only procedure value set uses NHI order codes, so GZQO-EXC-05 (bariatric surgery) reads unknown at every Japanese site; no Japanese procedure master is mapped
JC11 is accepted as a JLAC system name (source.py:168) but its codes are looked up in the JLAC10 table, which holds no JLAC11 row: a site on JLAC11 gets no LOINC code for its results
No HOT-to-ATC table ships: a HOT-only drug reaches ATC only through the site's drug master (HOT to YJ); the shipped YJ sample covers 22 of the synthetic hospital's 36 drugs
The synthetic memory clinic's report kinds (MRI brain, amyloid PET, CSF amyloid) have no LOINC rule in any mapping; no shipped criterion reads them today
